DebugLogging.Name: MediaSoupVTT Debug Logging
DebugLogging.Hint: Outputs verbose logging to the console for debugging purposes.

ServerUrl.Name: MediaSoup Server WebSocket URL
ServerUrl.Hint: The WebSocket URL of your MediaSoup server, for example wss://your.server.com:4443. Changing it reconnects everyone's audio/video.

AuthToken.Name: MediaSoup Server Auth Token
AuthToken.Hint: Shared secret required by the MediaSoup server (its MEDIASOUP_AUTH_TOKEN). Leave blank if the server runs without authentication. Stored as a world setting, so every player in the world can read it.

Menu.Name: MediaSoup Server Configuration
Menu.Label: Configure MediaSoup Server
Menu.Hint: Set the MediaSoup server connection and read the setup guide.

ConfigDialog.Title: MediaSoupVTT Configuration
ConfigDialog.ServerUrlPattern: Enter a WebSocket URL starting with ws:// or wss://
ConfigDialog.GMOnly: Only a Gamemaster can change the server settings.

SettingsHelp.Title: Quick Setup Guide
SettingsHelp.Step1: Run the MediaSoup server and enter its WebSocket URL (and auth token, if it uses one).
SettingsHelp.Step2: Open Configure Audio/Video (Core settings) and set the Audio/Video Conference Mode to Audio/Video, Audio Only or Video Only. MediaSoup is used automatically; there is no separate mode to pick.
SettingsHelp.Step3: Choose your microphone, camera, voice mode and push-to-talk key in Configure Audio/Video too.
SettingsHelp.Note: While this module is enabled it replaces Foundry's built-in peer-to-peer audio/video.
